title: Repair metric convergence and trace continuity for Dedicated tenant during regional failover
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Customer escalation: multiple Dedicated tenants reported missing timeseries and broken dashboard panels after a regional capacity failover. Symptoms included metric duplication during rehydration, missing span links in traces for affected request IDs, and dashboard tiles showing stale ‘no data’. This ticket tracks investigation, hotfix, and permanent remediation to ensure metric convergence and trace continuity across Dedicated and Private deployments.
steps_taken: 2025-02-17 03:12 UTC: Pager notified on SEV2. Triage started by on-call SRE (Marcus Chen).
Captured ingestion window for affected tenants and exported raw ingestion logs for shard ranges 12..18.
Isolated root cause to asynchronous watermark rollback in the dedicated ingestion coordinator triggered during failover which allowed duplicate replays and skipped span stitching events.
Applied emergency guard: temporarily paused eager replays and switched dedupe window to strict monotonic watermark for impacted tenants (hotfix deployed 2025-02-18 01:46 UTC).
Ran controlled replay for backfilled windows with dedupe and sequence alignment to restore converged metric series (completed 2025-02-20).
Deployed permanent fix: coordinator now persists epoch checkpoints and enforces idempotent replay using composite (tenant,shard,sequence) keys (released console-2025.03 on 2025-02-27).
Validated dashboard tiles and trace links with synthetic traffic and sample queries; completed customer smoke tests with FinLedger and Acme on 2025-03-01.
root_cause: During a regional failover the dedicated ingestion coordinator reverted an internal watermark epoch to a prior value for a subset of shards. This allowed buffered replays to inject duplicate metric points and omit span stitch events because upstream sequence tokens were considered already-seen based on inconsistent ephemeral caching. The combination led to non-monotonic time-series and broken trace links in the Console for affected tenants.
resolution_summary: Hotfix: prevented eager replay and enforced longer-lived dedupe keys to block duplicates. Permanent fix: persisted epoch checkpoints in durable storage, tightened coordinator commit protocol to atomic epoch increments, and added an offline convergence job that reconciles divergent series and reinserts missing span stitch events where possible. Instrumentation added to alert on epoch regressions and non-monotonic series for faster detection.
